offering_description.value: Develops and sells prescription drugs for immune thrombocytopenia, acute myeloid leukemia and certain RET-altered cancers. It uses contract manufacturers and reaches hospitals and specialty pharmacies through U.S. distribution networks. It also licenses commercialization rights to pharmaceutical companies in select international markets.

primary_products.value: fostamatinib for chronic immune thrombocytopenia; olutasidenib for IDH1-mutated acute myeloid leukemia; pralsetinib for certain RET-altered cancers

customer_segment.value: B2B: Specialty drug distributors, specialty pharmacies, hospitals, oncology practices and pharmaceutical licensees

revenue_model.value: product sales: Prescription drugs sold through specialty drug distribution networks; licensing or royalties: Drug development and commercialization rights, with milestone payments and royalties under licensing agreements

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: Develops or licenses drugs, contracts out manufacturing and markets them through specialty distributors and pharmacies

geography_served.value: global: United States directly, with licensed commercialization in Canada, Europe and parts of Asia

specialization.value: related lines: Prescription therapies for blood disorders and genetically defined cancers

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Specialty drug distributors and specialty pharmacy networks; partners / resellers: Pharmaceutical licensees in select markets outside the United States

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA and foreign marketing approvals, clinical trial oversight, pharmaceutical manufacturing standards and drug safety reporting

notes: The current product portfolio and licensed territories may have changed.
